summary: Targeted the open gap on the configuration-recovery question with a new three-node experiment: voters A, B, C where A snapshots under the committed {A,B,C}, the leader removes C (committed {A,B}) and commits more entries, A restarts with RestoreCommittedLogs on, and B is partitioned while C stays connected. Added source src_follower_append_entries (raft.go:1458-1603) and submitted the fixed harness draft/assurance_multi_test.go with one admission (restart tracking three voters while the log's committed configuration has two, B disconnected, C connected) and one comparison whose antecedent is 'A became leader' and whose assertion is that no entry may be committed with only A's and the removed server's acknowledgement. Local construction feedback showed A tracking the snapshot's stale three-voter configuration, winning the election, and applying 'stale-quorum-entry' with apply_error nil while B's log lacked the index and C's log held it at the same term; the retained receipt is pending.
